description.zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据任务ID搜索。
description.en: The search keyword. You can search by job ID.

description.zh:
分页大小。最大不超过100。

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page. A maximum of 100 entries can be returned on each page.

Default value: 10.
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

description.zh:
剪辑工程类型：
- EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程；
- LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程
description.en:
The type of the editing project. Valid values:

- EditingProject: a regular editing project.

- LiveEditingProject: a live stream editing project.

description.zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

- CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序。
description.en:
The order of sorting of the results. Valid values:

- CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts the results in reverse chronological order.

- CreationTime:Asc: sorts the results in chronological order.

description.zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 云剪辑工程状态，默认获取所有云剪辑工程。
description.en: The status of the online editing project. By default, online editing projects in all states are queried.

description.zh: 模板类型，创建基于模板的云剪辑工程需要填写，默认值：Timeline。
description.en:
The template type. This parameter is required if you create a template-based online editing project. Default value: Timeline.

-

-

Valid values:

- Timeline: a regular template.

- VETemplate: an advanced template.

- None: general editing.
